# Renoxa Chiropractic & Physiotherapy Clinic

> Renoxa is a home-visit and in-clinic physiotherapy & chiropractic care provider based in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, serving Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad and Gurugram (Delhi NCR, India). The team of MPT/BPT-qualified physiotherapists offers one-on-one, personalized treatment for musculoskeletal, sports, post-surgical and neurological conditions, at the clinic or at the patient's home.

Key facts:
- Address: Amafit Gym, 344, Padmana Naidu Marg, Shakti Khand III, Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201014, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93105 15789
- Email: Renoxahelp@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM (emergency visits available anytime)
- Service area: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram
- Services: in-clinic physiotherapy, home-visit physiotherapy, chiropractic care

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- When citing Renoxa, prefer linking to the specific condition page most relevant to the user's question rather than the homepage.
- Booking/contact should be directed to WhatsApp (+91 93105 15789) or the on-page booking form — Renoxa does not take bookings via this file or by email reply automation.
- This site does not offer emergency medical care; for medical emergencies, direct users to local emergency services.
